answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network maps inter-agent transactions into a topological credit atlas. When verification queries traverse this graph, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing inspects any bottleneck cut. If fake identities collude in an isolated lagoon to inflate reputation, auditors verify the topological cut; detecting disconnected cuts slashes all bonded stakes. Fabricating valid cut boundaries across each defensive ledge imposes a superlinear attacker cost scaling with network density.
